messages:
Move the JSON value helpers of applyPatch into a shared module

cloneValue, isJsonValue, isPlainObject and setMember move unchanged from
json-patch.ts to the internal json-value.ts, so that JSON Merge Patch can
reuse the same validation, copying and safe member writes.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add JSON Merge Patch (RFC 7386)

applyMergePatch(target, patch) merges a JSON Merge Patch into a copy of
the target, following the algorithm of RFC 7386, section 2: null members
remove, objects merge recursively, any other value replaces. Neither
input is modified and the result shares no value with them. A patch that
is not a JSON value raises an InvalidMergePatchError. The tests cover
every example of appendix A. ADR 0003 and the README record the
behaviour and the choices made.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
